card.text: Icy moon of Saturn streaked with bright ice cliffs.

introduction.text: Dione's bright wisps are canyon walls of ice, some hundreds of metres high. Helene and Polydeuces share its orbit.

normal.title: Global image mosaic
normal.summary: Detail varies across images from Cassini and Voyager; shadows in the photographs remain.

enhanced.title: Enhanced-color composite
enhanced.summary: Infrared, green and ultraviolet bands from 2014 show colors beyond human vision; shading and seams remain.

elevation.title: SPC terrain model
elevation.summary: Height above or below a 561.4 km sphere from Cassini's 2025 model, with about 1.58 km spacing.

relative-albedo.title: SPC relative brightness model
relative-albedo.summary: Brightness solved with the Cassini shape, relative to an average of 1, and less tested than the heights.

shape.title: SPC shape model
shape.summary: Plain surface over a 2,000-face version of Cassini's Q128 shape; small terrain is left out.

infrared.title: Cassini VIMS infrared mosaic
infrared.summary: Photometrically corrected infrared spectra, shown in false color.

ice-absorption.title: Continuum-relative water-ice absorption
ice-absorption.summary: Strength of water-ice absorption, measured from the original spectra.
